female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-institutional-partner-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster.
female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Pitches from women that mention specific institutional partners, such as NWTF, are associated with increased funding speed.

female-family-responsibilities-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention family members or household responsibilities fund more slowly.
female-family-responsibilities-slower.body: Pitches from women that reference family responsibilities or household duties are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-dreams-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their dreams or aspirations fund faster.
female-dreams-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference their dreams or future aspirations are associated with increased funding speed.

community-benefit-faster-general.body: Pitches that mention benefits to the local community or neighbors may fund faster regardless of gender.

female-local-currency-faster.body: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.

female-partner-loan-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention a history of previous loans from their partner may fund faster.

female-photo-explanation-slower.body: Female borrowers who include a note explaining their photo may fund more slowly.

female-template-phrasing-slower.body: Female borrowers who use nearly identical template phrasing in their pitches may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly thank lenders in their pitches may fund faster.

female-inventory-lists-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of inventory items may fund more slowly.

female-age-faster.body: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund faster.

female-self-descriptive-adjectives-slowe.body: Female borrowers who use descriptive adjectives like 'hardworking' or 'resilient' may fund more slowly.

female-specific-inventory-faster.title: Female borrowers who list a wide variety of specific inventory items fund faster.
female-specific-inventory-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for corroborated claim regarding location and routine details

female-number-of-children-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children they have may fund faster.
female-number-of-children-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning children correlates with slower funding

female-location-ops-slower.title: Pitches from women that include specific descriptions of their daily routines or the physical environment of their business are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-location-ops-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for female-dreams-faster claim

female-boilerplate-agri-slower.title: Female borrowers who use generic or identical phrasing regarding agricultural inputs may fund more slowly.
female-boilerplate-agri-slower.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for photo-explanation observation

female-longer-business-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify a longer duration of business operation may fund faster.
female-longer-business-history-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower pitches mention longer business histories

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include thank you messages to lenders or organizations may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that thank you messages correlate with faster funding

female-concrete-details-faster.title: Female borrowers who include specific concrete details, such as inventory types or children's ages, may fund faster.
female-concrete-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed inventory lists correlate with slower funding

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'hardworking entrepreneurs' may fund faster.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain puzzle cap for female-age-faster

female-farm-expansion-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of expanding their farm may fund more slowly.
female-farm-expansion-slower.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for female-self-descriptive-adjectives-slower
